title: cupressus goveniana var. cornuta
intro: Cupressus goveniana var. cornuta, commonly known as California red cedar, is a species of evergreen tree native to California, USA. This plant is valued for its wood, essential oils, and traditional medicinal uses. The health benefits of California red cedar include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may aid in reducing pain, improving respiratory health, and preventing infections. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including cedrol, cedrene, and calamenene, which exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic properties.
